question: Do the model-3 Rust plant options, and a conditional experiment using measured spark/cam/lambda with a small declared fit on training bands, reduce disagreement with measured Mazda shaft torque, fuel-meter flow and inlet air on complete held-out speed bands?

historicalBaseline.proof: Optional: path supplied in ENGINE_LAB_MAZDA_BASELINE; unavailable unless supplied.
historicalBaseline.reproduction: If supplied, compare E0 to historical lab-generic-ve torque, fuel and net-inlet-air on the original twelve development rows. Report the maximum relative difference as a diagnostic, not a real-engine accuracy result.

evaluation.call: evaluateEngine(engine, physical, measuredRpm, throttle=1, boostFraction=0, measuredBoundary)
evaluation.torque: Rust EngineEstimate.torqueNm = net cylinder work (pumping included once) minus Rust FMEP friction
evaluation.air: Rust netInletAirMassFlowKgs (forward minus reverse intake-valve flow), compared with the inlet LFE

conditions.exhaustPressurePa: measured catalyst inlet absolute pressure + exhaustPressureOffsetKpa (0 for every scored experiment)
conditions.exhaustTemperatureK: mean measured cylinder 1-4 exhaust port temperatures +273.15

fuel.source: fixture.fuelAnalysis (ASTM D3343 carbon weight fraction 0.86678, status Reference Only; LHV 42.887 MJ/kg)
fuel.stoichiometricAfr: same equation and constants as Rust FuelChemistry::stoich_afr (dry air N2/O2/Ar/CO2); self-checked against the Rust burned-gas equivalence ratio

experiments.label: Model-2 physics (legacy defaults), generic assumed VE-map lift fit
E0 + NASA-7 fixed-composition properties + Woschni heat transfer; no measured controls, no fit
E1 with valve-geometry airflow (no lift fit to the generic VE map); no measured controls, no fit
E1 + measured spark, cam phases and lambda; valve-geometry airflow (no VE-map lift fit); base offsets 0
E2a with the declared parameters fitted on training bands only

measuredControls.intakeCamRetardDeg: Intake Cam Phase + intakeCamBaseOffsetDeg (channel sign: + = later, verified from Valve Overlap = exhaust - intake - 24 deg where unclipped; channel zero is unknown, hence the fitted base offset)
measuredControls.baseValveEvents: generic lab defaults IVO 710, IVC 220, EVO 500, EVC 10 deg (not Mazda data); the cam retard shifts opening and closing together

fit.trainingRows: split.trainingRows (1500/2000/3000/4500 rpm bands, 46 rows incl. the 12 inspected)
fit.optimizer: bounded Nelder-Mead on the unit cube (validation/fit.mjs), deterministic start, simplex step 0.1, tolerance 1e-9 relative

stages.objective: mean over training rows of ln(predicted/measured)^2; a non-admitted row or non-positive prediction contributes 1.0
mean over training rows of (predicted-measured)^2 in Nm^2; a non-admitted row contributes 2500

notFitted: friction (FMEP base/speed): not separable from combustion efficiency with steady brake torque alone; oil temperature range too narrow
DI evaporation (not implemented; not separable from breathing in these data)
fit.frozenBeforeEvaluation: Every choice in this file is committed before any E2b fit or any holdout row evaluation. Any later change is logged in IMPLEMENTATION.md and relabels the affected split as development.

assumedSigma.airMassFlowGs: 1% of reading (assumed LFE uncertainty, not an EPA statement)

jacobian.scaling: rows divided by sigma; columns multiplied by the parameter bound range; central differences with step 1% of range
jacobian.rank: numerical rank = singular values >= 1e-6 * largest; practically identifiable directions = singular values >= 1 (a full-range move changes the stacked normalized residual by at least one sigma)

exhaustPressureSensitivity.purpose: unmeasured header loss upstream of the catalyst; diagnostic only, never used to choose parameters

admission: requested physical inputs not silently normalized
boundary reproduced (MAP and exhaust pressure per row; intake/exhaust temperature boundary verified once on the probe cycle config)
mass ledger residual <= 1e-12 kg and energy ledger residual <= 1e-8 J
no generic VE-map extrapolation (ve-map-fit experiments only; valve-geometry does not use the map as a target)

relativeDenominator.note: rows with |measured| below the threshold keep absolute metrics but are excluded from relative metrics; 13 of 137 rows have |torque| < 5 Nm

reporting: Training and holdout metrics separately, per experiment and per speed band; every row retained with predictions, admission reasons and band. Power and BSFC are derived from torque and fuel and are not independent evidence. No accuracy pass threshold is declared.
assumptions: Generic SI plant conditioned on measured boundaries; not an identified Mazda digital twin.
Holdout bands come from the same engine, cell and session package; they test speed interpolation/extrapolation, not an independent engine or campaign.
The PFI/equivalent-heat fuel path stays; the Mazda is DI. No charge-cooling or spray model.
Spark->SOC offset is a single fitted constant, not a predictive ignition-delay model.
Wall temperature stays the assumed 450 K; coolant/oil temperature is not substituted for gas-side wall temperature.
